I want to know customs charges to get a miner into canada

No customs charges for Canada. Orders to Canada ship from our Canadian warehouse, so nothing is collected by the carrier on delivery. The only extra is sales tax where it applies, and that's added at checkout along with shipping, so you see the full total before you pay.

Are you looking at the Magic Miner 40T? It's $799 USD, and that's a pre-sale unit.
yes I am and I live in north bay ontario.  do I have to pay extra beyond this initial presale price?

Beyond the $799, two things get added at checkout: shipping, calculated from your (address hidden) address, and Canadian sales tax. Nothing else. No duty and no customs fee on delivery, since it ships from our Canadian warehouse. You see the full total before you pay.

The batch you're looking at ships December 14, 2026.
